as_read: Positive for short-term symptoms and leg volume in chronic venous insufficiency, with caveats, at doses stated as aescin; not superior to placebo in advanced disease; labels print extract mass with no aescin in the rows and no venous claim.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named in the abstract; leg pain and leg volume reported
studies_to_add.quote: The evidence presented suggests that HCSE is an efficacious and safe short-term treatment for CVI.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named as primary; the stated efficacy aim is oedema reduction, measured as lower leg volume
studies_to_add.quote: Significant oedema reductions were achieved by HCSE (p = 0.005) and compression (p = 0.002) compared to placebo, and the two therapies were shown to be equivalent (p = 0.001); in this design, however, compression could not be proven as standard with regard to oedema reduction in the statistical test procedure.

stop_list: Fields can't express an aescin dose against labels that print only extract mass; packet dose values for 8569363 and 11747472 are aescin mg, 50 mg twice daily.

Rule 2 strictly: no abstract read uses the words primary outcome for an extract arm against placebo. 8569363 names oedema reduction as its efficacy aim, so the route is packet_no_credit rather than no_qualifying; main session may want to rule on this. Its full text has no PMC id.
labels.py rows show no aescin; the label panels themselves weren't opened.
clinician_items: 11747472: in the full text of the early disease trial, nausea, heartburn or fullness occurred in 4 patients (4%) on extract and 2 patients (2%) on compression.
23152216: adverse events were usually mild and infrequent; the abstract gives no pregnancy, bleeding, liver or drug interaction data, and raw seed toxicity was not reviewed here.
stored_rating_note: Stored 15106197 is the 2004 Cochrane version. The 2012 update (23152216) has more trials and a smaller leg volume effect, 32.1 mL against 56.3 mL. Stored positive_moderate is not out of line for venous insufficiency, but no label here carries that purpose. The packet's body direction, positive_weak, reflects the caveats and the null trial in advanced disease.
unread_notes: Abstracts, plus 11747472 (PMC61039) full text searched for dose, design and adverse events, with numeric results not extracted. PMC7144685 (23152216) returned HTTP 500 from Europe PMC, so the Cochrane full text was not read and its primary outcomes and doses are unknown. 8569363, 8737631, 16620045 and 12518108 have no PMC id. Two searches used.
